QuestInfo.name: MapleStory Newbie
QuestInfo.1: Find those who are still growing in Maple World. #bJoin a party with players who are Lv. 30 or lower#k.\r\n\r\n#r<<To clear this mission you must make a party with a player on the same screen as you.>>#k

1.0: Look at that, you've found the ever-growing warriors of Maple World. I hope you can be a good ally of theirs. It's not much, but take this gift from me!
